The carbon-13 ($^{13}\text{C}$) NMR spectrum of compound $\textbf{A}$, $\text{C}_8\text{H}_8\text{O}_2$, contains six peaks.
Compound $\textbf{A}$ reacts with an excess of bromine water to give compound $\textbf{B}$, $\text{C}_8\text{H}_6\text{Br}_2\text{O}_2$.
Compound $\textbf{A}$ reacts with alkaline aqueous iodine to form a yellow precipitate $\textbf{C}$ and compound $\textbf{D}$.
Compound $\textbf{D}$ reacts with $\text{PCl}_5$ to form compound $\textbf{E}$, $\text{C}_7\text{H}_5\text{O}_2\text{Cl}$.
Compound $\textbf{E}$ reacts with propan-2-ol to form compound $\textbf{F}$.

parts.text:
Draw the structures of compounds $\textbf{A}$, $\textbf{B}$, $\textbf{C}$, $\textbf{D}$, $\textbf{E}$ and $\textbf{F}$ in the boxes.
